title: Big Lush Cave Panorama (Shaders)
description: A panorama with an enormously big and beautiful Lush Cave; now with shaders!
body:
I've stumbled upon this cave randomly and couldn't resist making it my panorama for the main menu, thought the others might like it too, so there you have it!

The seed, shaders and coordinates go:
```
-1859944319469820894, /tp @s 35.99 23.36 -93.43
Complementary Shaders r5.8
```
